name: Razis
description: One of the elders of Jerusalem, a lover of his countrymen and of very good report, called a father of the Jews for his kindness; when Nicanor sent five hundred men to take him, he fell upon his sword rather than be taken, and when his stroke missed he cast himself down from a wall, and at the last, with his bowels in his own hands, called upon the Lord to restore them to him again, and so died

points: Razis, one of the elders of Jerusalem, a lover of his countrymen: that is nationalism, that is loving your race. For his kindness he was called a father of the Jews.

note.label: In Vain Do They Worship Me! Religious Syncretism
